intent.raw: Review and refresh the IOLM UI implementation SWU because its Goal and task boundary are too large.
intent.objective: Produce an exact proposal-only refresh that replaces the unexecuted UI-A bundle with the smallest coherent sequential SWUs while preserving the approved sidecar outcome and authority boundaries.
intent.operator_sentence: Review the oversized workable-example SWU, propose a smaller receipt-bound route, and do not apply or implement it yet.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Distill Standard uses Proposer and Balancer roles, but repository governance requires explicit user confirmation before subagent dispatch.
subagent_strategy.explanation: No subagent dispatch was authorized for this Refresh. The parent records the same Proposer/Balancer trace locally in DISTILL-REVIEW.md.
context: The target is one bounded proposal-only refresh.
No parallel mutation or independent research corpus is needed.
The user requested review and refresh, not delegated execution.

boundaries.from_owner: operator, accepted IOLM planning, execution profile, and Inventory
boundaries.contract: Current files and selector-bound execution evidence may trigger a planning correction but cannot become implementation or completion evidence.
The four-unit split must preserve the approved parent outcome, exact package boundary, one-at-a-time selection, and typed recomposition handles.
Proposal completion is not apply authorization. Target planning, Craft, historical evidence, implementation, DomainSpec, and public Arcanum remain unchanged until exact approval.

boundaries.to_owner: compiler, DomainSpec authority, CAV2 authority, and publication owners
boundaries.contract: The split changes execution granularity only. All four receipts remain ineligible for 00C-B, 00C-C, G-DSV2-SG, CROSS_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED, promotion, and publication.

authority.lifecycle: invoke refresh owns proposal authoring only
authority.validation: Context Builder, Distill review, Dispatch Spec, source hashes, JSON, target inventory, and diff boundary
authority.evidence: owner-held current planning files plus immutable execution-profile evidence
authority.memory: Inventory remains a non-authority lookup surface
authority.promotion: private IOLM, DomainSpec, CAV2, Craft, and publication owners remain separate

state_namespaces.owner: IOLM planning, accepted research, execution-profile, Craft, and Inventory owners
prior Context Builder and Goal profile runs
state_namespaces.write_policy: immutable until approved apply adds a separate supersession marker

state_namespaces.owner: future A1 through A4 Task Sessions

promotion_splits.target: compiler support, candidate-substrate proof, authority, promotion, or publication
promotion_splits.rule: Execution granularity does not alter the six-value ineligibility fence.

steps.name: Select strict review and target context

inputs.ref: operator size concern plus current UI-A execution evidence

stop_conditions: block if an obligation is uncovered
block if a source preimage is stale

steps.name: Resolve IOLM strategy handle and target inventory

capability_metadata.scope: repository-local machine-index lookup; Inventory remains non-authority

stop_conditions: block if index.json is absent or unparsable
block if Inventory is treated as authority

steps.name: Review the current SWU and prove the smallest coherent replacement
stop_conditions: block if a unit has no primary behavior
block if a unit lacks independent acceptance
block if recomposition needs hidden glue

steps.name: Author the exact proposal-only split delta
stop_conditions: block if the parent task outcome changes
block if original UI-A is treated as passed or as a parent SWU
block if more than A1 is selected after apply
block if 00C-B/C or authority state changes
block if target files change in proposal-only mode

steps.name: Validate proposal structure, dispatch, evidence, and mutation boundary
stop_conditions: block on Dispatch Spec or JSON failure
block if any target or implementation file changed
block if the proposal does not preserve historical evidence

gates.condition: All nine review obligations are covered by fourteen current selector-bound sources.
A1 is the narrowest trust-building unit and A1 through A4 each close one behavior and recompose without hidden glue.
The four typed handles reproduce the unchanged parent task outcome and preserve the gateway replacement seam.
Only the dated proposal package and one observability run record change.
Every proposed unit preserves the full ineligibility fence and cannot affect 00C-B/C or authority.
Apply waits for exact approval of REFRESH-PATCH-PROPOSAL.md.
Dispatch, JSON, source-hash, target-inventory, proposal-only, and diff checks pass.
